summary: Lower eyelid; its margin sits near the lower limbus and carries the tear meniscus.

margin_height.note: Distance of the lid margin below the pupil centre (margin reflex distance 2).

fissure_half_width.note: Half the horizontal fissure width, from the canthi.

fissure_centre_offset.note: Horizontal offset of the fissure centre from the iris centre (+ = toward the lateral canthus), from the canthi. Negative: the fissure centre lies nasal to the cornea.

apex_offset.note: Horizontal position of the lowest point of the lid margin.

apex_height.note: Depth of the margin below the line joining the canthi.

swelling.note: How far oedema pushes the lower lid margin toward the eye (mm), with the swelling fading over the 4 mm of lid next to the margin; 0 in a healthy lid. Render-calibrated (low confidence).

provenance.source: Margin and apex values derived from the trace in assets/exterior/fissure.json (51.2 px/mm; MRD from the pupil centre (1408, 870) px), checked by the validator within 0.05 mm. Normal ranges: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.
